dedupe_keys.name: equalization in dispersion managed systems using learned digital back propagation

description: Napoli, Antonio and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. A deep neural network optimises digital-back-propagation parameters using stochastic gradient descent. Simulations use dual-polarisation transmission at 32 Gbaud per channel over 28 spans of 72 km, with 15% residual dispersion. Single-channel and WDM cases compare linear equalisation, conventional DBP and learned DBP. Coverage is this numerical fibre-link experiment; reported SNR and Q-factor gains depend on its modulation and dispersion conditions. Frequency-domain implementation is also compared with time-domain processing for complexity. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
